name: copy-ratios
title: Copy ratios
description: Segmented MCCA copy-number ratio data. Values come from the source LOG2FC field and are shown as log2 copy-ratio heatmap values. These values are not purified copy-number calls, and this track does not include loss-of-heterozygosity information.

color.description: Source LOG2FC value for the segment. Negative values indicate relative copy loss, positive values indicate relative copy gain, and the color scale is clamped for readability.
